post.title: Why a Skipped Message Hurts So Much #shorts
post.description: Ever been left out of the group chat? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who got skipped. Leo's group chat skips his message, again, and it ruins his night. In 'Cyberostracism: Effects of Being Ignored Over the Internet' (Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2000), Kipling Williams, Christopher Cheung and Wilma Choi had 1,486 people from 62 countries play Cyberball, an online game of catch; after just a few minutes of not getting the ball, people reported lower belonging and self-esteem, and felt sad and angry. In 'Does Rejection Hurt? An fMRI Study of Social Exclusion' (Science, 2003), Naomi Eisenberger, Matthew Lieberman and Kipling Williams found that being left out of the game raised activity in the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex, a region tied to the distress of physical pain. You're not being dramatic: social pain is real. #psychology #shorts #ostracism #groupchat #overthinking
